description: This is an abstract base class for upgrade testing within an Orleans-based project. It manages starting and stopping silos with different grain versions, handles configuration, and provides test infrastructure for version upgrades of grains in a test cluster environment.

classes.name: UpgradeTestsBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing infrastructure for Orleans silo upgrade tests, including starting/stopping silos with different grain versions, managing a test cluster, and executing version upgrade scenarios.

methods.name: Step1_StartV1Silo_Step2_StartV2Silo_Step3_StopV2Silo
methods.description: Coordinates the process of starting a V1 silo, then a V2 silo, and finally stopping the V2 silo, verifying grain versions at each step.

methods.name: ProxyCallNoPendingRequest
methods.description: Tests proxy call behavior ensuring no pending requests remain during a version upgrade scenario.

methods.name: ProxyCallWithPendingRequest
methods.description: Tests behavior when a proxy call is made during an active long-running request, verifying correct version handling.

methods.name: StartSiloV1
methods.description: Starts a silo with version 1 of the grain assembly.

methods.name: StartSiloV2
methods.description: Starts a silo with version 2 of the grain assembly.

methods.name: StartSilo
methods.description: Internal method to initialize and start a silo with the specified grain assembly.

methods.name: StopSilo
methods.description: Stops a specified silo handle and removes it from management.
